summary: Prorated downgrade credit missing after timezone-tagged usage reclassification
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightWay Health downgraded their Dedicated reserved capacity plan mid-billing cycle (2026-03-05). They expected a prorated credit for the remaining reserved hours on the final invoice. Finalized invoice shows no prorated credit and a higher than expected charge.

Impact:
- Overcharge on the finalized invoice for BrightWay Health (enterprise customer).
- Customer is disputing the charge and has paused autopay for the invoice.
- Potential loss of trust: customer uses Redwood for production inference for clinical triage workloads.

Environment:
- prod account for BrightWay Health
- Dedicated pool: d-ephemeral-uswest-7
- Billing window: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31

Steps to reproduce (observed by support):
1) Customer performed a UI plan downgrade on 2026-03-05 23:45:12 local (PST) which should have triggered a reserved-hours prorate calculation.
2) Billing service ingest pipeline receives postbacks from meter-proxy with timestamps normalized to UTC but with a "tz_tag" header set to "us-west".
3) Postbacks for a small burst of usage were reclassified into the previous hourly bucket (2026-03-06 00:00 UTC) during the postback reorder window.
4) Invoice generator used the hourly accumulator snapshot and did not apply the reserved-hours refund line for the remainder of the cycle.

Observed behavior:
- No prorated reserved-hour credit line present on finalized invoice INV-2026-03-0819.
- Postback logs show extra entries with local timestamps that were shifted across the billing hour boundary when the tz_tag was interpreted twice.

Expected behavior:
- Invoice should include a prorated credit reflecting unused reserved capacity hours between 2026-03-06 and 2026-03-31.

Logs / artifacts provided by customer:
- UI replay trace id: ui-req-8a5f2b
- Sample postback payloads (attached via secure upload token) with header tz_tag: us-west
- Finalized invoice pdf: INV-2026-03-0819.pdf

Initial support triage notes:
- Customer-facing billing agent verified invoice and requested escalation to Billing Engineering.
- Notified Finance and flagged as high-touch enterprise dispute.
- Put autopay hold and created provisional waiver request; awaiting engineering confirmation before applying credits.
steps_to_reproduce: Downgrade dedicated plan in Console at local time near hour boundary
Check postback payloads for tz_tag header
Run billing-service accumulator for the affected hourly snapshot
investigation_notes: 03/10 12:10 PST - Support: validated invoice and gathered postback samples from customer.

03/10 15:45 PST - Billing Eng (Miguel): reproduced accumulator mismatch locally when tz_tag header present. Hypothesis: double-normalization bug in postback-processor that applies tz shift and then also converts timestamp to UTC again using header offset.
03/11 09:20 PST - SRE: confirmed postback reorder window closed at 2026-03-06T00:05:00Z; a 3-minute buffer ingress caused events to be assigned to previous hour when double-normalized.
03/11 14:05 PST - Finance: provisional credit amount calculated ($4,620.00) but hold until fix verified.
comments: Support (Aisha): Reached out to customer 2026-03-10 12:22 PST, requested postback samples and invoice PDF. Customer provided attachments via secure upload.

Billing Eng (Miguel): I can reproduce locally with the provided payloads. Creating instrumented run to show how accumulator snapshot differs when tz_tag is present. Raising PR to add defensive parsing: github.com/redwood-inference/billing-service/pull/1872.

SRE (Lena Chu): Postback-processor instances in us-west showed a rolling restart on 2026-03-06 00:01 UTC which may have caused reordering. We're adding stronger idempotency checks and making the tz_tag an advisory only.
Finance (Omar Rahman): Calculated provisional credit and awaiting engineering confirmation. If confirmed, we will issue a manual credit and regenerate invoice. Customer asks for ETA for resolution.
Customer (BrightWay billing contact - Jenna Kline): Thank you for the fast triage. We need the corrected invoice within 3 business days to close our internal month-end. Please advise next steps.
Support (Aisha): Confirmed plan to apply manual credit after engineering patch is deployed and invoice is reissued. Will buffer customer autopay hold until customer approves final invoice.
temporary_workaround: Manual invoice adjustment and one-time credit to match expected prorate. Finance prepared a provisional credit in ledger but will not post until engineering confirms correctness.
resolution_notes: Pending - engineering patch merged to billing-service (PR #1872) and deployed to staging 2026-03-11. Post-deploy verification steps: 1) reprocess affected postbacks through patched pipeline 2) regenerate invoice INV-2026-03-0819-draft 3) Finance to apply manual credit and finalize invoice. Target date to complete: 2026-03-12.
postmortem_followup: Add e2e test covering tz_tag and hour-boundary downgrades
Instrument postback-processor to emit a tz_classification metric for alerts
Update billing runbook to include autodetect for double-normalized timestamps
Billing: create monitoring alert for large invoice deltas after finalization (> $1k per invoice)

2026-03-11 16:00 PST - Support informed customer that engineering has a patch in review and Finance prepared provisional credit.
2026-03-12 10:32 PST - Support to confirm when invoice is reissued and obtain customer signoff before unholding autopay.
